snapshot.consistency_note: The MCP accepts individual SELECT statements, not a multi-statement snapshot transaction. The barangay component and sector aggregates were therefore captured 16 seconds apart.
snapshot.grain: Barangay aggregate; no business names, addresses, or business/log IDs exported.
snapshot.scope: All 16 current barangays; no dashboard, registry, flag, date, or inspection filters beyond model eligibility.

model.distance: Haversine 6371.0088 km from BPLO to mean valid dispatchable Red/Yellow coordinates; cap distance penalty at 20 km; neutral proximity 50 for missing coordinates.

sensitivity.range: Exploratory local perturbation: each criterion may move by at most 10 percentage points from the baseline, in 5-point increments; every scenario is nonnegative, at most 100, and sums to 100.
sensitivity.reason: The checked-in policy documents the 68/7/25 interview-derived baseline and valid 0-100 weights totaling 100, but no AHP matrix or operational weight ranges. The bounded +/-10 percentage-point range is a transparent local stress test, not an endorsed policy interval.

baseline_parity.comparison: Notebook perturbation scorer at 68/7/25 versus calculate_rankings() from the current checkout and the same frozen inputs.
baseline_parity.not_claimed: This does not independently verify which source revision/configuration is currently deployed in the live API process.

query_method: Read-only aggregate SELECTs mirror the current _PIN_ACTIONABLE_SQL, _effective_flag_color_sql ladder, _no_open_inspection_sql, _barangay_rankings_sql, _prescriptive_sector_sql, and dispatch identity logic.
